remarks: Welcome to 38 Soundview Avenue, Unit B- where comfort meets coastal living! This beautifully maintained 3-bedroom, 2 full bath rental offers the perfect blend of space, style, and convenience. Featuring a modern kitchen with stainless steel appliances, this home is ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. Enjoy the ease of a private washer and dryer, central air conditioning, and two dedicated parking spaces.  The spacious layout provides flexibility for living, working, and relaxing, while the home's bright and inviting interiors create a warm, welcoming atmosphere throughout.  Located just moments from Cove Island Beach, you'll love having access to scenic waterfront views, walking trails, and outdoor recreation right at your doorstep. Conveniently situated near shopping, dining, and major transportation, this rental truly checks all the boxes.  Don't miss this opportunity to enjoy the best of Stamford living!
